title: Azure CLI sign-in state
whyItMatters: Cached Azure sign-in tokens and subscription settings let someone use the account's cloud access from this machine.
source: Azure CLI configuration and cached credentials in ~/.azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/azure-cli-configuration
notes: Older CLI versions use accessTokens.json; newer ones use an MSAL cache. On macOS tokens may be backed by the Keychain, which is not accessed.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Azure CLI sessions this account uses, or revoke the device sessions in the Azure portal.
steps: Sign out of the Azure CLI so its cached sign-in tokens stop working.
Open Keychain Access and remove any leftover Azure token entries.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: You must sign in again for the next Azure command; subscription choices stored on this Mac are lost.
